# hush_pinot_access_credential (Resource)

Manage Pinot dynamic access credentials in the Hush Security platform. Hush creates a Pinot `USER` per workload through the controller's `/users` API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create a Pinot dynamic access credential. host and port name the controller;
# the cluster must keep its users in ZooKeeper (ZkBasicAuthAccessControlFactory).
resource "hush_pinot_access_credential" "example" {
  name                = "prod-pinot"
  description         = "Production Pinot credential"
  deployment_ids      = [hush_deployment.example.id]
  host                = "pinot-controller.example.com"
  port                = 9000
  username            = "admin"
  password_wo         = var.pinot_password
  password_wo_version = "1"
  broker_url          = "http://pinot-broker.example.com:8099"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `deployment_ids` (List of String) List of deployment IDs that can access this credential. Currently limited to a single deployment. Changing this after creation is not supported; the credential must be deleted and recreated.
- `host` (String) The hostname or IP address of the Pinot controller. Hush writes users through its `/users` API, so the cluster must keep its users in ZooKeeper (`ZkBasicAuthAccessControlFactory`)
- `name` (String) The name of the Pinot access credential
- `username` (String) The username of an `ADMIN` user on the Pinot controller. It must be able to read the controller's `/appconfigs`, which is how Hush checks the access control

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `broker_url` (String) The `http(s)` URL of a Pinot broker (e.g., `http://pinot-broker:8099`), with no credentials, query, fragment or whitespace. If set, Hush checks that the broker accepts each generated user, and delivery templates can use it as `${broker_url}`. Behind a load balancer the check reaches one broker only. A trailing `/` is dropped
- `description` (String) The description of the Pinot access credential
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The password of the Pinot controller user
- `password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The password of the Pinot controller user (write-only). This is a write-only attribute that is more secure than `password` because Terraform will not store this value in the state file. Either `password` or `password_wo` must be specified.
- `password_wo_version` (String) Used to trigger updates for `password_wo`. This value should be changed when the password content changes. Can be any value (e.g., a timestamp, version number, or hash).
- `port` (Number) The port number of the Pinot controller (default: 9000)
- `secret_store_id` (String) The ID of the secret store where this credential is saved (optional)
- `tls` (Boolean) Whether to use TLS for the Pinot controller. `broker_url` carries its own scheme. Set without `tls_ca`, it verifies neither the controller's certificate nor that of an `https` `broker_url`
- `tls_ca` (String) The TLS CA certificate that verifies the Pinot controller and an `https` `broker_url`, in place of the system CAs, so both need certificates from it

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the Pinot access credential
- `kind` (String) The kind of access credential
- `type` (String) The type of access credential
